title: GSMTAP: Ignore radio fields for SIM type
description:
Instead show the SIM subtype.

Before the `gsmtap_channels` enum was used to show the SIM subtype in the GSMTAP header.

ATR was shown as "Channel: BCCH", and TPU command header as "Channel: AGCH"

Sample pcap file same as in !16896
